name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Marketing Strategist & Content Lead
summary: Marketing strategist with 15+ years across agency and founder-led environments, autonomously owning multi-client account portfolios end to end while producing the copy, content, and campaign strategy behind them. Built an AI-driven outreach system that scores a business's digital footprint and personalizes engagement at scale, and translate loosely-defined client goals into structured content and campaign logic. Comfortable owning accounts independently, staying current on channel shifts, and using AI tooling to keep content production moving at agency pace.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own the primary strategic relationship for a portfolio of B2B clients, running discovery and onboarding to surface goals and translate them into campaign and content strategy.
Draft direct-response copy, outreach sequences, and landing pages that drive engagement and pipeline across multiple concurrent client accounts.
Write and publish thought leadership content, newsletters, and educational guides tailored to each client's brand voice and audience.
Architect AI-driven outreach systems that score a business's digital footprint and generate hyper-personalized messaging at scale.
Translate non-technical stakeholders' loosely-formed ideas into precise, structured content and campaign instructions, bridging business intent and execution.
Design self-improving loops and evaluation frameworks to monitor content and campaign performance, continuously refining messaging based on results.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Produced high-converting campaign assets - landing pages, complex email sequences, conversion-focused copy - improving lead generation and pipeline across multiple client accounts.
Managed integrated digital marketing strategies across inbound, paid media, and content as strategic lead, coordinating execution across internal departments.
Held delivery quality consistent across implementations, resolving client feedback promptly to protect satisfaction and retention.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Advised partners on how to communicate product value to their own customers, developing training content and messaging that reduced onboarding friction.
Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partner accounts simultaneously (deal sizes ~$10K-$45K), retaining roughly 94% during tenure.
Analyzed partner utilization and performance metrics to identify adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.
Collaborated with Product and Engineering to share structured, high-priority customer feedback informing the roadmap.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Ran client accounts end to end at a performance marketing agency, covering campaign execution, content, and cross-team communication.
Built and refined internal processes that improved reporting accuracy, reduced handoff errors, and strengthened cross-team alignment.
Closed 6 new-client deals during tenure, averaging ~$22K each - roughly $130K+ in total bookings.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Managed a high-value account portfolio across diverse verticals, contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.
Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.
Directly managed and developed a team of onboarding specialists, overseeing budgets, scope, and delivery for a high-value client portfolio.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Sold and scoped complex CRM and project-management software to agencies and professional-services firms, translating client needs into product narratives.
Guided client onboarding and built relationships with C-Suite executives as a trusted advisor on operational system design.
Ranked top three in sales on a team of 8 to 15 reps for effectively the full tenure, holding that ranking while quota roughly doubled over the period.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
certifications: Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Professional Certificate - Google / Coursera (Sept 2024)
